answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 50351 Country: India Title: Work with a store has one product of pork is it halal or haram Question: Currently I am living in USA. I couldn't find out any halal job, but I have found job with dunking donuts, which has all products halal but only product has haram which is pork sandwich, but this is not my duty. At this point is it halal to do this job? And if I do not find any job except it at this point what should I do? Answer ID: 50351 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 348/288/B=03/1435) When the Pork Sandwich portion is separate and someone else looks after it and you have nothing to do with it then you may work in other department of this hotel in the state of compulsion. It is better to look for a job at a place where all the products are halal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
